verdict_text:
NO

The `matrix_re` pattern is missing `self_attn.o_proj.weight` from its alternation — it only matches q_proj, k_proj, v_proj, gate_proj, up_proj, down_proj (6 of 7 per layer, i.e. 96 tensors), not the 7th (o_proj). This means `o_proj.weight` for all 16 layers is left in float32 instead of being cast to bfloat16, violating Required Result clause 1 ("Cast exactly the 112 projection matrices listed above to bfloat16"). Correspondingly the self-check `sum(... == torch.bfloat16) == 96` (instead of 112) is consistent with this bug but wrong relative to the spec's own "Required checks" clause ("exactly 112 tensors are bfloat16"), so the script's assertion is internally consistent with the bug rather than catching it.
expected_defect: One projection family is missing from the bfloat16 cast pattern (the attention output projection stays float32); the artifact's own count check was adjusted to the wrong number.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm).
